note: Machine-readable companion of docs/vision/DATASET_PROVENANCE.md. 'status': approved = used by the pipeline today; planned = needs an owner decision or download approval first; excluded = not to be used. Evidence: VERIFIED = read from the primary source on the date; DOCUMENTED = secondary source; ASSUMED = not verified. This is an engineering record, not legal advice.
